note: Eldorado NF horse camp on a forested ridge 7.5 miles east of Georgetown off Wentworth Springs Rd, open to campers without horses. Equestrian and RV sites alternate around one gravel loop, with corrals, hitching posts and high lines between sites. Bring drinking water. --Claude
summary: Dru Barner (Eldorado NF): FS page + rec.gov facility/rules/rates/catalog/availability. HORSE-RULE DROP CANDIDATE: 26 equestrian and 22 RV sites interleaved in one loop with high lines between sites, no separate horse area. Facts confirmed: $8 all year, 48 sites (46 take 23 ft+), year-round, reservable with 9 first-come sites, 14-day limit. Temporarily closed for road repair to 11/29/26 (status written). No drinking water (potable false). Phone and website given.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (horse rule): a horse camp with the horse sites mixed into the general loop, no separate horse area. rec.gov: 'This campground was designed for equestrians, but it can also be used by tent, camper, trailer and recreational vehicles.' 'Some of the camp units have horse corrals nearby. There are also hitching posts near some of the restrooms and high line posts between camp sites.' FS: 'The campground is ideal for equestrian use, with four water troughs'. Catalog: 26 EQUESTRIAN and 22 RV sites interleaved through one loop (1 RV, 2 EQ, 3-4 RV, 5-6 EQ, 7 RV, 8-12 EQ, 13-14 RV, 15-16 EQ, 17-19 RV, 20-23 EQ, 24 RV, 25-29 EQ, ...). Under the any-owner horse rule (horse sites mixed into the general loops, no explicit separation) this is a drop candidate; the reviewer decides.

STATUS: temporarily_closed written, reopens 2026-11-29 (tentative), for road repair per the FS banner. 'Space 10 will remain closed until further notice.' If it reopens on time, the status can be cleared to open.

FACILITIES: potable water - FS static text says 'Potable water is available' (faucets at the kitchen and units 9 and 11), but its current conditions say 'No water available at this time' and rec.gov's notice says 'Non-potable water ... bring your own drinking water'. Written potable_water false. Toilets: FS 'Restroom Type = Vault'; rec.gov also describes 'a two-unit flush restroom equipped with sinks' - flush left unset because the sources conflict.

SITES: FS's own breakdown ('Tent Site # = 32', 'Tent, Trailer, or R.V. Site # = 15', 1 double) contradicts rec.gov's catalog, where 46 of 48 sites permit an RV/trailer with 30-60 ft limits. rec.gov catalog used (trust rec.gov).
PHONE: empty -> 530-333-4312 (Georgetown Ranger District; FS page and rec.gov facility phone). rec.gov's 530-334-6477 is the FS page's 'Rock Creek Trail Status' line - not used.

OHV (not a flag for this entry): rec.gov says it is 'close to the Rock Creek Trail System that has both non-motorized, motorized, and multiple use trails', but the campground stages non-motorized (horse) trail use only; not an OHV staging camp.
